parameters.query: SELECT id, path, suggested_type FROM alice.dms_watched_folders WHERE enabled = true ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

parameters.content:
## alice-dms-scanner (Dispatcher)

Scheduled hourly (07:00-22:00).

Loads active folders from alice.dms_watched_folders, atomically locks each free folder in Redis
(PROJ-72, per-path lock) and fires the alice-dms-path-worker sub-workflow per locked folder
WITHOUT waiting for it to finish (fire-and-forget via Execute Workflow, waitForSubWorkflow=false).
Folders already locked by a still-running worker are skipped this run. All actual file scanning,
hashing, lifecycle detection, stability check, OCR check, and MQTT routing now lives in
alice-dms-path-worker.json (see that file's sticky note).

### Redis Lock Keys (PROJ-72)
- `alice:dms:scanner:lock:folder:<folder_id>` — JSON {owner, path, folder_id, started_at, last_heartbeat},
  NX+PX 180s, ownership-checked renew/release (Lua). Renewed once per file by the Path-Worker.

### Dispatcher Stats Redis Keys (PROJ-72)
- `alice:dms:scanner:dispatch:run_start` — Epoch ms of this dispatcher run
- `alice:dms:scanner:dispatch:stats:dispatched` — Counter: folders successfully locked+dispatched this run
- `alice:dms:scanner:dispatch:stats:skipped_locked` — Counter: folders skipped (already locked)
Published to alice/dms/scanner/stats (lightweight dispatch summary, no file counts —
see alice-dms-path-worker for per-path file stats on alice/dms/scanner/path_stats).

### Stale Path Sweep (PROJ-44, unchanged)
Runs once per dispatcher execution (global, not per-folder) after all folders have been
dispatched/skipped. Detects deleted files via alice:dms:path_to_hash and publishes
delete_file lifecycle events to alice/dms/lifecycle.
